title: Leaked audio: San Francisco and Austin first responders told the NHTSA that Waymo robotaxis are "backsliding" and committing more traffic violations than before (Aarian Marshall/Wired)
summary: Aarian Marshall / Wired: Leaked audio: San Francisco and Austin first responders told the NHTSA that Waymo robotaxis are “backsliding” and committing more traffic violations than before — “I believe the technology was deployed too quickly in too vast amounts, with hundreds of vehicles, when it wasn't really ready …
contentText:
Aarian Marshall / Wired :

Leaked audio: San Francisco and Austin first responders told the NHTSA that Waymo robotaxis are “backsliding” and committing more traffic violations than before   —  “I believe the technology was deployed too quickly in too vast amounts, with hundreds of vehicles, when it wasn't really ready …
